answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 10507 Country: India Title: ASSALAMUALIKUM WHAT ISLAM SAY ABOUT BEARD LEANTH OF BEARD IT IS COMMPULSORRY TO GROW BEARD IN ISLAM SEND FATWA PLEASE. Question: ASSALAMUALIKUM WHAT ISLAM SAY ABOUT BEARD LEANTH OF BEARD IT IS COMMPULSORRY TO GROW BEARD IN ISLAM SEND FATWA PLEASE. Answer ID: 10507 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 102/109=L/1429) Men are asked to keep beard at least to one fist length. It is unlawful to cut it below one fist and shaving is haram and major sin. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
